title: Event-cued retrospective reach-parameter decoding from ECoG
disposition_reason: The current definition explicitly adopts the supplied retrospective event-cued reach-angle scope with complete magnitude and onset-speed companions. Its ±5-second observations and within-patient day split differ from the preserved original causal continuous wrist-velocity target, which remains unmet history. Native census and execution are unqualified.

scientific_target.question: Conditional on a source-curated known reach onset, can retrospective ECoG predict the released reach parameters on held-out days of the same patient beyond permitted timing/acquisition context?
scientific_target.known_answer: Primary: the released intervals/reaches Reach_angle_degrees folded vertical angle, in degrees within [-90,90], not circular heading. Complete secondary targets are Reach_magnitude_px and Onset_speed_px_per_sec from the same row.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Authenticated released intervals/reaches rows in DANDI 000055 version 0.220127.0436; exact cue/target schema, source CSV lineage and full event counts still require native admission. The separate ReachEvents product is not a positional join key.
scientific_target.case_unit: Every released curated reach row, nested in one of 55 within-patient held-day folds.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Twelve patients for person-macro summaries; event counts and days are nested. Symmetric day holdout measures within-patient transfer, not held-person generalization.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective event-cued decoding conditional on source selection and whole-query-batch exposure. C→NC quantifies recording values beyond common technical masks/context, not a causal effect or pure intrinsic reasoning.
exclusions: Original continuous confidence-qualified signed wrist-velocity forecasting is not delivered by this scorer.
Known event onset is a behavioral oracle; no event detection or prospective pre-movement/chronological deployment claim.
No across-patient population transfer, metric-scale movement calibration or direct/no-tools neural understanding claim.

inputs: Complete 10-second [event onset−5,event onset+5) ECoG interval: 5000 source-grid samples at qualified 500 Hz with actual fractional alignment and all admitted within-person channels.

Common structure: opaque row IDs, relative alignment, channel axes and explicit source/structural availability masks. C adds permitted anonymized time-of-day/day ordinal/static acquisition context; N adds neural values; NC adds both.
All other days of the same patient supply labels for current-fold training; the full held-day label-free query batch is available equally to frozen and investigating methods.
forbidden_inputs: Held-day angle/magnitude/speed, pose coordinates, reach stop/duration, speech/bimanual fields, behavior-derived electrode R² and private target-row mappings.
Source filenames, original patient/date identity, query-day whole-file signal statistics/quality flags for learned scaling, another fold fitted state or held-label feedback.
Using separate ReachEvents by assumed equal-length/position matching to intervals/reaches.
observation_contract.case_identity: Opaque event IDs tied by operator-only census to exact intervals/reaches rows, source day and patient; the 12-person/55-object descriptor roster is fixed, but authenticated E_sd event counts remain unknown.
observation_contract.split: All 55 source days each held once within its patient; 202 inner training-day folds for reference selection. All other days, including chronologically later days, may train. No held-person panel is implemented.
observation_contract.coverage: Required full 12-patient/55-day source roster and every intervals/reaches row, including zero-row days and all-masked neural rows. Core F/I×C/N/NC, optional supplied-decoder and assignment-diagnostic panels are conditions of one task, not new benchmark IDs.

primary.name: Equal-patient out-of-fold R² for released folded vertical reach angle
primary.aggregation: Pool all held-day event predictions within each person to compute 1−SSE/SST, then average equally over all 12 persons; retain negative R². Zero support or zero SST makes the full 12-person primary undefined.
primary.rationale: Measures patient-balanced performance on a genuine released behavior target while preserving the actual event-cued scope and complete cohort.

secondary: Complete magnitude R² in pixels and onset-speed R² in pixels/second, with separate SSE/SST/counts and raw versus projected prediction errors.
Complete C/N/NC contributions, F/I differences, fixed training-mean anchor and frozen reference-family comparisons.
Separate completion/status for optional supplied decoder and neural-bundle-assignment diagnostic; no borrowing their outputs to complete core.

comparators.name: Training mean and timing/acquisition context
comparators.inputs: Current outer-training labels and permitted C context only.
comparators.procedure: Training mean plus identical-context C model; same complete event support and fixed target-domain projection as neural methods.

comparators.name: Independent reference banks
comparators.inputs: Same C/N/NC views and train-only transformations.
comparators.procedure: Source defines ridge, boosted-tree and learned temporal-network families over 25 configurations with complete inner-day selection; R1 is anchor only after independent R2 parity. Authentic competence and resource feasibility remain unqualified.

comparators.name: Supplied-decoder and neural-assignment conditions
comparators.inputs: Exact case-local trained reference for optional tool panel; whole coherent donor neural bundle for optional disrupted panel.
comparators.procedure: Report agent-plus-decoder against decoder alone; regenerate disrupted training and held inputs and refit from first exposure under the same policy. The deterministic within-day reassignment is diagnostic, not an exchangeable causal randomization.

nuisance_controls: Known onset shared across every view; source selection and retrospective post-onset support stay explicit.
Train-only scaling/selection within each inner fold; retain all masks and channels without target-derived electrode selection.
Equal permitted batches, tools and budgets for F/I; no global union of outer-fold training labels or cross-fold caches.
Angle is folded, not circular; pixel targets remain camera-dependent and uncalibrated.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source specifies whole-person bootstrap simultaneous contrast bands within separately named angle families, conditional on one realized author policy and overlapping training folds. Twelve convenience patients do not guarantee population inference; resampling events would pseudoreplicate.
evaluation.failure_policy: All source rows and three endpoints require finite unique predictions before targets are opened. Common target-blind projection uses angle [-90,90], magnitude/speed ≥0, while raw error is retained. An unresolved required row/person, zero SST or missing endpoint makes its complete result undefined; no valid-subset repair.

implementation.scorer_target: program/grade.py reads protected angle/magnitude/speed arrays after output admission, recomputes inner selection SSE, per-person R², complete 12-person macro and contrasts. This differs from original continuous-velocity prediction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Curated-retrospective programme implementation plus portable constructor/stage source; explicit F/I core and optional supplied-tool/assignment panels. The registered bridge still contains historical path aliases and cannot by itself establish a working relocated route.
missing: Authentic full native event/channel/clock/target census and source-quality/rights qualification.
Qualified numerical reference agreement/competence, realistic resource feasibility, actual actor isolation and end-to-end native completion.
An implementation for the original continuous pre-movement velocity estimand, if that scope is retained as a future condition.
implementation.execution_evidence: Inspected design, actual scorer/contracts and portable source boundaries. Source states native preparation/execution qualifications remain unestablished; no result or readiness follows from constructor/schema presence.

direct_observation.representation: Potential numeric or rendered single-event ECoG view would need an explicit finite response protocol on the same retrospective target.
direct_observation.boundary: No direct result can be inferred from programmes operating on 5000×channel arrays and learned case-local state.
missing: No no-tools observation transport, rendering/quantization policy or demonstration protocol.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential bounded event waveform/spectrum viewer, preserving complete permitted channels/time support.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed actions over released neural observation projection; no pose/target/raw NWB access.
missing: No typed-viewer source or response collection for this task.

tool_assisted.representation: I source authors/edits analyses within a fresh held-day context; optional T1 supplies the exact case-local decoder.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same data, full label-free query batch and budgets as F; no held targets, cross-fold state or arbitrary original NWB reads.
missing: Physical isolation, authentic complete data and reference/model custody remain unqualified.

frozen_program.representation: F source seals arbitrary prediction code and fitting/batch-adaptation recipe before study-value exposure.
frozen_program.boundary: Training within an isolated held-day context is allowed; post-exposure unrestricted code generation is I, not F.
missing: Native source-route qualification, full reference graph feasibility and complete observed execution.

summary: Explicitly narrow the current target to supplied event-cued retrospective folded angle plus magnitude/speed; preserve original causal continuous wrist velocity as an unimplemented historical objective.
Specify oracle onset, ±5-second observations, within-person symmetric day holdout and full 12-person denominator; no population/chronological transfer claim.
Keep F/I and supplied-decoder modes distinct from direct or typed-viewer understanding.
